raw_text: `content/` bilingual: sibling `_index.de.md`/`_index.en.md`, mirrored/synced YAML front matter (`title`, `date`, `draft`, `weight`, `archetype`; ISO timestamps). Extend `layouts/partials/`, `layouts/shortcodes/`; never edit `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`. CSS: `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`; pass-through `static/`; Hugo `public/`/`resources/` only via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`. Diagrams `svg/` or beside Markdown. Use Hugo Extended v0.120+. `#` titles; `##`/`###`; Markdown lists/tables. Lowercase domain folders/files; media nearby. Use existing shortcodes. Run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings` before every commit; today that build is the test suite. Add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings`. Preview: `hugo server --disableFastRender -D --buildFuture --navigateToChanged`; deploy: `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings --cleanDestinationDir`; snapshots: `hugo server --renderToDisk --printUnusedTemplates`. Spot-check `public/search/index.json` in Chromium/Firefox. Focused imperative commits. Include regenerated `public/`; PRs list paths, issues, screenshots/zipped previews, and state whether `hugo --gc --minify` ran clean.
